og.title: Infectious Control for the Business Owner | CARSI
og.description: For owners and managers responsible for building, operating and defending an infection control service offering. Covers the science, the business and legal obligations, WHS documentation, chemical management, ATP hygiene verification and the operational frameworks behind a compliant service.

faq.q: Who is this course designed for?
faq.a: Business owners and managers in the cleaning and restoration industry who are responsible for building, operating and defending an infection control service offering.

The science of infection control, the business and legal obligations, pre-job preparation, WHS documentation, chemical management, ATP hygiene verification, and the operational frameworks needed to deliver the service.
Australian commercial and residential markets, with the aim of delivering infection control services that are compliant, profitable and defensible.
